If the pre-World Cup predictions come true, one of the teams that will play at the stadium in Houston today may be the Dutch national team. Four years ago in Qatar, she finished in the best eight. Can Memphis Depay and company improve this result?

programme.title: Boxing: Gala in New York – summary
programme.desc: Jorge Garcia Perez and Xander Zayas will fight for the vacant WBO World super middleweight belt at Madison Square Garden. For the Puerto Rican, undefeated in his career so far, this is the first fight with such high stakes. Perez already holds the IBO World title, but in a lower weight class

programme.title: Boxing: Gala in Los Angeles - junior heavyweight: Badou Jack - Noel Mikaelian
programme.desc: Badou Jack starts the second defense of the WBC World cruiserweight belt. Noel Mikaelian will try to take it away from him once again. In May this year, the fight between these boxers lasted 12 rounds and ended with the judges' decision

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Wisła Płock – KGHM Zagłębie Lubin
programme.desc: Wisła Płock's good start to the season cannot under any circumstances lull the Oilers' vigilance. The last time the team from Płock started the competition at the highest level so well was in the 2022/2023 campaign. Despite an excellent start, the Płock team was relegated to the 1st league. Now they don't want to let that happen. Today they will do everything to defeat KGHM Zagłębie Lubin

programme.desc: The clashes between Legia Warszawa and Jagiellonia Białystok are slowly starting to aspire to be league classics. The fans of Pride of Podlasie dream of a revenge for the last meeting of both teams from last season. The military won 3-1 and eliminated Jagiellonia in the quarterfinals of the Polish Cup. However, more than the result, there was talk about refereeing errors in favor of the Warsaw team

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Korona Kielce – Motor Lublin
programme.desc: In the first rounds of the new season, Korona Kielce is far from optimal. A week ago, however, the Golden Bloods were able to snatch points from Lech in Poznań. Now they will face Motor Lublin at their own facility

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Widzew Łódź – Pogoń Szczecin
programme.desc: The absence of Efthymios Koulouris in the match against Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza (1:1) caused a wave of speculation about the Greek's future in Pogoń Szczecin. If the sniper does not play in Łódź, Widzew's chances of winning will increase significantly

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Górnik Zabrze – GKS Katowice
programme.desc: After a very disappointing start to the season, GKS Katowice wants to finally start scoring points. Rafał Górak's players are counting on winning the extremely prestigious match against Górnik Zabrze. However, the hosts will be the favorites

programme.title: I was a king - Tomasz Frankowski
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. The hero of the next episode is Tomasz Frankowski. The striker won the title of top scorer in the Ekstraklasa four times and won the Polish championship five times with Wisła Kraków. In total, he scored 168 goals in the league. Frankowski is a symbol of the golden era of the Krakow club. We will also see his performances in Jagiellonia Białystok. The authors also return to the famous decision to omit him from the World Cup squad. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: I, the captain – Jakub Czerwiński | E07
programme.desc: Eight profiles of captains of clubs playing in the PKO Bank Polski Ekstraklasa. These are the top players on their teams. They are at different stages of their careers, have different personalities, life principles and stories, but they are united by their love for football and the desire to win. These are eight great leaders. This time we will meet the mainstay of Piast Gliwice's defense, Jakub Czerwiński. The 32-year-old has a menacing appearance, but is calm and hard-working. He values ​​professionalism and draws strength from his family and religion. Czerwiński won the Polish championship three times in his football career. He dreams of further successes with the Piast team. Poland. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Radomiak Radom – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza
programme.desc: A good start of the season by Radomiak Radom must please the fans of this club. The team from Mazovia is aiming for the top half of the table and is not afraid of anyone. In this round, the Radom team will face Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza, which is also doing decently at the start of the competition.

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 1st round singles match: Eva Lys – Emma Navarro
programme.desc: Emma Navarro came to Bad Homburg after a successful tournament in Nottingham. The American reached the final, where she lost to Marie Bouzkova. Now he wants to transfer the form from British courts to German courts. Eva Lys will try to stop her, with whom she will face for the first time in her career. The winner of this match will compete with Iga Świątek in the second round

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Wang Xinyu – Leylah Fernandez
programme.desc: Wang Xinyu started her fight with a confident victory against Renata Zarazua. Now the Chinese woman will face the higher-ranked Leylah Fernandez, whom she will face for the first time in her career. The winner of this match will compete with Elina Svitolina in the quarterfinals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Naomi Osaka – Elise Mertens
programme.desc: Both women last met on the court in 2024 in Toronto. At that time, Elise Mertens was on top, defeating Naomi Osaka 6:3, 6:4. In Bad Homburg, the Belgian wants to repeat this result and thus reach the quarterfinals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Lyudmila Samsonova – Elina Svitolina
programme.desc: Elina Svitolina has already entered one quarterfinal during this year's competition on grass. In Berlin she advanced, defeating Eva Lys. In Bad Homburg, Lyudmila Samsonowa will once again stand in her way, with whom she will face for the first time in her career

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Ekaterina Aleksandrova – Mirra Andreeva
programme.desc: Mirra Andreeva returns to the game after winning the French Open Grand Slam. The Russian will play her only tournament before Wimbledon on grass courts in Bad Homburg. A demanding rival awaits her at the very beginning of the competition. She will face Ekaterina Aleksandrova, with whom she has only competed once. In 2025 in Stuttgart, she lost to her 3:6, 2:6

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Zheng Qinwen – Clara Tauson
programme.desc: Both women last met on the court in 2020 in Oerias. Back then, Clara Tauson was on top, defeating Qinwen Zheng 6-0, 3-6, 6-4. In Bad Homburg, Dunka wants to repeat this result and thus reach the quarterfinals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Iga Świątek – Emma Navarro
programme.desc: Iga Świątek decided to play her only tournament before Wimbledon on the courts in Bad Homburg. Previously, she reached the finals, where she was defeated by Jessica Pegula. This time, in the second round, she will face Emma Navarro, with whom she has a score to settle. During last year's competition in Beijing, the American defeated the Pole 6:4, 4:6, 6:0

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Karolína Muchová – Irina-Camelia Begu
programme.desc: Both women last met on the court in 2024 in Palermo. At that time, Karolina Muchova was on top, defeating Irina-Camelia Begu 6:1, 6:1. In Bad Homburg, the Czech wants to repeat this result and thus reach the quarterfinals

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Górnik Zabrze – Legia Warszawa
programme.desc: An absolute hit of the Polish league and the most interesting match of the eleventh round. The leader Górnik Zabrze takes on Legia from Warsaw, who will play this match after a 0-1 defeat in the Europa Conference League against Samsunspor. In the match against the Turks, coach Edward Iordanescu fielded a heavily reserve squad, saving the best players for Górnik

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lechia Gdańsk – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: The first matches of Lech Poznań this season could not fill the fans of the Polish champion with optimism. Kolejorz lost the national Super Cup match against Legia 1:2, and at the inauguration of the Ekstraklasa it was defeated 1:4 by Cracovia. However, the Poznań team rose from its knees and won against Icelandic Breidablik 7:1 in the Champions League qualifiers. Lech will try to transfer the form from this match to the league pitch and defeat Lechia Gdańsk

programme.title: Football: Spanish league: FC Barcelona – Sevilla FC
programme.desc: The previous clash between FC Barcelona and Sevilla FC ended with a high victory for the team from Andalusia (4:1). Robert Lewandowski missed his chance to reduce the losses of the Pride of Catalonia by missing a penalty kick.

programme.title: Football: Spanish league: Getafe CF – Real Betis Balompie
programme.desc: In the previous round, Getafe won sensationally against Real Madrid at the Santiago Bernabéu. In this exciting match, we saw two red cards, one for both teams. José Bordalás's team won 1-0 thanks to a goal by Martin Satriano. The Uruguayan volleyed and gave the Royal goalkeeper no chance. However, the Blues face another difficult challenge. In the 27th round they will face Real Betis, which is also at the top of the table and remains undefeated in five matches.

programme.title: Derby Law | E04
programme.desc: The creators of the series take viewers behind the scenes of one of the hottest speedway competitions in Poland - the Lubusz Land Derby. Cameras follow the players of Falubaz Zielona Góra and Stal Gorzów throughout the season - from the preparation period to key matches. They focus not only on sports competitions on the track, but also on the emotions, passion and rivalry that connect the regions. It's time for the derby of the Lubusz Voivodeship. The meeting in Zielona Góra traditionally arouses many emotions. After this clash, both teams are struggling with problems. They suffer painful defeats. At the end of May, the match between Stal and the team from Grudziądz ends in a mutual walkover. Poland. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Speedway: PGE Ekstraliga: BAYERSYSTEM GKM Grudziądz – PRES Grupa Deweloperska Toruń
programme.desc: The revelation of the regular phase takes on the reigning Polish champion in the blockbuster of the 11th round of the PGE Ekstraliga. In the previous meeting of these teams, the speedway riders from Toruń were better, beating GKM Grudziądz 48:42

programme.title: Leaders. In the center of the game – Rifet Kapić | E02
programme.desc: The series directed by Maciej Klimek presents five PKO BP Ekstraklasa players who took responsibility for their teams at the decisive moments of the 2025/26 season. The heroes are Jesus Imaz (Jagiellonia Białystok), Rifet Kapić (Lechia Gdańsk), Radosław Murawski (Lech Poznań), Julian Shehu (Widzew Łódź) and Karol Czubak (Motor Lublin). Cameras follow them on and off the pitch, showing the pressure, behind-the-scenes of matches and their private lives. Rifet Kapić is one of the key figures of Lechia Gdańsk in the 2025/26 season, in which his team fought for a long time to stay in the PKO BP Ekstraklasa. In difficult moments, the team needs strong characters like its captain. Kapić comes from the Bosnian province, but thanks to determination and consistency, he is building an international career step by step. Poland. 2026. documentary series

Atomic Dog» Originally from Jackson (Mississippi), a state in the deep American south, Audie Norris (1960) is considered the best foreign player for Barça basketball. In the six years he was in the Barça team he won three leagues and two King's Cups. He spent three seasons in the NBA, in Portland, the same city and the same team where Fernando Martín played. Two players who revitalized a sport with their colossal duels in the paint. He was fired from Barça in 1993. A year later, in the Greek Peristeri, he left basketball because of his knees, the only ones that managed to stop him on the court and which tormented him throughout his entire career. He returned to the US. Bad investments left him on the brink of bankruptcy. He decided to turn his life around and return to the city that saw him shine. And 28 years after being fired he has returned to the club of his life. Since 2021 he has been a Barça ambassador

programme.desc: «Robinson Report (7): From Conchi Amancio to Conchi Maradona» 50 years ago the first women's football match was played in Spain. It happened in Madrid and the match ended with a result of five goals to one in favor of Sizam, a team led by a 13-year-old teenager named Conchi Sánchez. Hers were the five goals for which from that day on she became known as Conchi Amancio. She thus became the highest representative of a group of pioneers who fought to develop a sport for which their country was not prepared. That is why at the age of 15 he would make the decision to change scene and develop his career in a much more established championship like the Italian one. After 23 years in football, and after winning 8 Scudettos and 7 Italian Cups, Conchi left her host country renamed Conchi Maradona.

programme.title: Robinson Report (S7): From Conchi Amancio to Conchi Maradona

programme.desc: «Football according to Raúl (1): The whitest Cup» On June 4, 1980, we experienced a historic match in Spanish football, because it had never been played and will never be played again. That night the Real Madrid players and the eleven of their subsidiary took to the pitch at the Santiago Bernabéu to play in the final of the Copa del Rey. 40 years later Raúl intends to tell us that story of Castilla matagigantes and what happened to the players who lived that special night

programme.title: Football according to Raúl (T1): The whitest Cup
programme.desc: «Robinson Report (5): Magical Realism» After the 82 World Cup in Spain, a different and striking footballer landed in the southernmost province of the peninsula, due to his extraordinary quality, and his eccentric way of behaving outside the stadium. A halo of lyricism and a bag of countless legends, in which it is difficult to distinguish between reality and fiction, surround the eight years that the Salvadoran Jorge González, whom they called Mágico, reigned in Cádiz. Voices from all corners, many of them unpublished until today, remember a figure that will be part of Cádiz mythology forever.

programme.title: 30 for 30: Long Gone Summer
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

HSI conducts a controlled drug delivery in hopes of arresting a drug dealer. USA

USA

programme.title: d/s Airport Security 3: Peru. 15 s.
programme.desc: In this series, employees of the anti-smuggling and drug trafficking service at the international airport named after. Jorge Chavez in Lima, Peru, is faced with an unusual and very dramatic situation when they are forced to arrest a woman with two small children who was trying to sell cocaine. Next, you will see a scene of the arrest of an elderly man, which indicates the attempts of the drug cartels to find new ways of smuggling. A young woman sobs as she is detained for attempting to smuggle contraband. A young man, previously convicted of trying to smuggle drugs into the United Arab Emirates, arouses suspicion among the officers, and they decide to question him. Recent research reveals that some of our favourite dinosaurs were very birdlike, and that birds are an extant kind of dinosaursDocumentary series is dedicated to the majestic Animal Kingdom and its weirdest, most unusual creatures. Nature never stops surprising us with its unique species and evolutionary unlike living things. Have a look at species with extraordinary survival skills, animals who camouflage in a skillful way for different reasons, creatures that convincingly play dead, find out if a grasshopper can vomit. These and much more amazing facts about animals are there for you in Strange CreaturesDirector: Chad Barclay

programme.title: Africa's Wild Horizons: Crowded Islands (S2E4). Documentary about nature, adventure. USA, 2017. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: JAV. Год: 2017. S2, Ep4 «Africa's Wild Horizons»…On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. Surrounded by rich waters, they can find enough to feed themselves and their young. But life is full of challenges for the breeding gannets…Africa's Wild Horizons is a documentary series that takes the viewers on a fantastic journey to Africa's lands, completely untouched by civilization. Feel its untamed wilderness, uncover mystical secrets, explore its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna, home to iconic animals and creatures of all possible kinds, where every day is an endless struggle for survival, and only the strongest stays alive. Take a look at Waterberg- a South African land formed before terrestrial life itself, the Vredefort Dome- a crater left after a giant meteorite crash, Swaziland's endless savanna, ecosystem of the Kalahari and the Okavango and much more.Director: Werner Heffer

S1, Ep5 «Amazing Animal Friends»…This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a recued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish settersAmazing Animal Friends is a heart-warming, fun and fascinating series showcasing the most incredible stories of unusual animal friendships from around the world. programme.title: Wild Japan – land of a thousand islands
programme.desc:
Japan, with its four main islands and over 6,000 mostly uninhabited islets, stretches over 3,000 kilometers from the Sea of ​​Okhotsk to the Philippine Sea. Flora and fauna fascinate. 

On Honshu, the largest island, there is both urban areas and wilderness. At the temple complex, with the world's largest bronze Buddha statue, in the former capital Nara, wild sika deer are the attraction. The Japanese worship them as messengers of the gods. In addition, every year the impressive cherry tree blossoms in spring attract tourists from all over the world.

Macaques are also increasingly venturing out of the hinterland to find more convenient sources of food. For example, the curious monkeys bathe in hot thermal springs. The spectacle attracts many tourists, who in turn throw small treats into the water for the macaques. Only when the monkeys are full do they retreat into the wild in the evening.

programme.desc: Bị đẩy xuống dưới nước hơn một trăm năm trước bởi một vụ phun trào núi lửa, Jaime khám phá một nghĩa trang chìm ngoài khơi bờ biển Camiguin, nơi mọi thứ đều được bao phủ bởi san hô ngoại trừ cây thánh giá sắt khổng lồ.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S3 EP04
programme.desc: Bạn đã nghe nói về chiếc tàu trượt đi giữa hai khinh khí cầu chưa? Hay một cậu thiếu niên có sở thích biến khu nhà của mình thành khu vực nguy hiểm? Đây là những câu chuyện về những trò tiêu khiển bất thường nhất trong lịch sử.

programme.title: HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID S2 EP10
programme.desc: Những con thú huyền thoại được cho là đi lang thang trên trái đất, khủng bố, giết chóc và thậm chí chiếm hữu con người. Nhưng liệu những sinh vật này chỉ đơn thuần là ẩn dụ hay có bằng chứng nào cho thấy chúng thực sự được thả ra để tàn phá?

programme.title: PAWN STARS S24 EP615
programme.desc: Rick chuẩn bị cho trận chiến vì một cặp áp phích cổ điển, nhưng liệu anh có chiến thắng trong cuộc chiến? Trong khi đó, Corey nhìn vào chiếc loa phóng thanh của một lính cứu hỏa cũ. Liệu anh ta có thể bắt đầu một thỏa thuận hay anh ta sẽ bị sa thải?

programme.title: THE PICKERS S26 EP397
programme.desc: Trong tầng hầm rộng lớn của phòng trưng bày ô tô cổ điển ở Connecticut, Mike và Jersey chọn qua bộ sưu tập trọn đời. Nhưng cảm giác hồi hộp của cuộc rượt đuổi không là gì so với chuyến đi vui vẻ trên chiếc Locomobile đời 1908.

programme.title: THE TAIWAN WAY EP01
programme.desc: Để tìm kiếm sự bổ sung ý nghĩa nào đó cho thực đơn của Yumpling, Chris bắt đầu cuộc hành trình vào thế giới bánh bao đưa anh đến Din Tai Fung, một nhà hàng được công nhận trên toàn cầu.

programme.title: THE TAIWAN WAY EP02
programme.desc: Hãy theo chân Chris khi anh ấy đi sâu vào thế giới ngon lành của món Phở Bò, khám phá lịch sử phong phú của nó. Tại nhà hàng của Josh Wu, Chris khám phá kỹ thuật độc đáo khi kết hợp món súp với rượu vang đỏ.

programme.title: THE FOOD THAT BUILT THE WORLD S5 EP04
programme.desc: Vào cuối những năm 1800, hai dược sĩ cách nhau 1500 dặm chạy đua để tạo ra các lựa chọn đồ uống không cồn, tốt cho sức khỏe, khởi động toàn bộ ngành công nghiệp soda với những sản phẩm đột phá của họ: Hires Root Beer và Dr. Pepper.

programme.desc: Trong gần 70 năm, Disney đã vượt qua ranh giới của nghệ thuật và khoa học thông qua công việc của một nhóm gồm những người mơ mộng, nhà thiết kế và nhà xây dựng được gọi là Người tưởng tượng.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S5 EP01
programme.desc: Năm 1698, thuyền trưởng Kidd đột kích một con tàu trên biển và chiếm đoạt kho báu của nó... nhưng Kidd bị treo cổ trước khi tiết lộ nơi ông giấu nó. Chuyện gì đã xảy ra với chiến lợi phẩm bị thất lạc của thuyền trưởng Kidd... và giờ nó ở đâu?

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP13
programme.desc: Quân Đồng minh thực hiện Chiến dịch Overlord, một trong những cuộc xâm lược quân sự phức tạp và quy mô lớn nhất trong lịch sử, nhằm giải phóng nước Pháp bị chiếm đóng và mở ra một mặt trận thứ hai thực sự ở Tây Âu.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP14
programme.desc: Đồng minh và Nhật Bản đụng độ trong rừng rậm và đồng bằng châu Á, 'sân khấu bị lãng quên' của Thế chiến thứ hai, khi Mỹ nỗ lực đưa cuộc chiến đến tận cửa Tokyo.

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP05
programme.desc: Thợ săn kho báu Darrell Miklos và nhóm của ông có một phát hiện lâu đời hơn họ mong đợi. Sau đó, bằng chứng mới xuất hiện cho thấy nhóm có thể đã phát hiện ra một trận chiến thất lạc từ lâu tại Mục tiêu 4.

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP08
programme.desc: Có phải cướp biển thời hiện đại đang rình mò Tam giác quỷ Bermuda để tìm kiếm nạn nhân? Nhóm nghiên cứu xử lý vụ án phức tạp về một chiếc thuyền bị mất tích có tên là Ngân hàng Saba bị mất tích ở vùng lân cận Tam giác quỷ Bermuda vào năm 1974.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S14 EP08
programme.desc: Troy cố gắng một mình chạy kỷ lục 100 dòng. Ashley và Anna dấn thân vào một đầm lầy khét tiếng bị ma ám có tên là Nghĩa trang, trong khi Black Rambo tìm kiếm bộ dụng cụ tiêu diệt ma cà rồng huyền thoại.
